originality.rationale: The classical sixty Göpel tetrads and S6 symplectic action are already known and explicitly excluded. No inspected historical primary treatment gave the complete eleven-row Frobenius spectra and rational-node distributions, though these can be derived from the classical model. The closest 60-flag arithmetic classification on the Segre cubic differs already at transposition: its fixed-flag count is zero versus twelve fixed Göpel tetrads; the published Göpel-tetrad lattice deals instead with integer incidence spans. Historical priority is provisional.
residual_risks: Unindexed finite-geometry/Galois tables may already list some or all eleven spectra; search is not a uniqueness proof.
The full text of the Segre 60-flag result was not accessible; comparison relies on its indexed subject and an independent exact equivariance obstruction.
The underlying full S6 action is classical; the claim of originality is only the exact arithmetic evaluation, not the symplectic model itself.

value.rationale: A complete natural arithmetic classification, indexed by the standard six-Weierstrass factorization type, of all 60 geometrically canonical Göpel tetrads and individual rational nodes in each invariant tetrad. Distinguishes Galois descent of sets from their elements, gives exact zeta functions over all extensions, and identifies three branch-factorization patterns with no rational Göpel tetrad. This is not a random finite slice or a mere re-expression of the known geometric total 60.
